sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Briteline manufactures and distributes printable digital media, heat transfer vinyl, and banner materials for sign making and graphics applications.

Industry: Printing Materials & Sign Making Supplies · Size: not published · Products: Key Banner, Forward Banner, Duration Series Decals, Window Perf Films, Translucent PVC Film, Static Cling

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: briteline scores 58 of 100 (tier C) at 85% confidence. The score is carried by application fit (25/25), event engagement (15/15) and pain-point alignment (10/15). Nothing was found for company size, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on chemical resistance, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar resists solvents, cleaners and road chemicals without hazing. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (45% similar on vinyl, films, film, signage); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (38% similar on films, vinyl, graphics, window); Drytac (29% similar on films, film, media, vinyl). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.
